description: This file defines internal classes and interfaces related to transactional state storage, including the 'StorageBatch' class that accumulates storage events for batch processing in Orleans Transactions framework.

classes.name: ITransactionalStateStorageEvents
classes.description: Interface defining storage event methods for transactional state management, such as Prepare, Read, Cancel, Confirm, Commit, and Collect.

classes.name: StorageBatch
classes.description: Internal class that accumulates storage events, manages their sequence, and provides batch storage capabilities with support for conditions and follow-up actions.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores the accumulated batch of transactions into storage asynchronously.

methods.name: RunFollowUpActions
methods.description: Executes all follow-up actions added to this batch.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Records a read event, updates metadata timestamp.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Records a prepare event with transaction details.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Records a cancel event and updates prepares accordingly.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Records a confirm event and cleans up prepares that are confirmed.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Records a commit event with transaction details.

methods.name: Collect
methods.description: Records a collect event, removing commit records for a transaction.

methods.name: FollowUpAction
methods.description: Adds an action to be run after batch storage.

methods.name: AddStorePreCondition
methods.description: Adds a condition that must be true before storage.

methods.name: CheckStorePreConditions
methods.description: Checks if all store pre-conditions are satisfied asynchronously.
